## Black Panther Vol 6 2

> My uncle [S'Yan](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/S%27Yan_(Earth-616) "S'Yan (Earth-616)") is dead now. Murdered by [another king](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Victor_von_Doom_(Earth-616) "Victor von Doom (Earth-616)"). I loved him. But I wish he'd told me not just of the power of kings, but of the might of **the people.** I wish he'd warned me that they, too, have secrets. They, too, hold mysteries. They, too, possess a power all their own.

—[Black Panther](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/T%27Challa_(Earth-616) "T'Challa (Earth-616)")
